comment: Default-FAIL verification contract for T-004 (high, tdd). Required set per risk-gate-matrix.md tier high. Created at gate time by the 2026-08-17 quality-gate run; every check started at passes=false and was flipped only after the named command ran in this gate session, output saved to specs/epic-192-a4-facet-manifest/verification/T-004/gate-c1-checks.log. All nine deterministic checks passed on the first cycle (staleness suite 46/46 both runtimes; T-001/T-002/T-003 suites regression-free; risk/placeholder/workflow-state/task-state/component-coverage green). Stack 'shell' waives lint/typecheck/build (no toolchain, same rationale as the sibling contracts). check-component-coverage recorded present but not required (CAPABILITY_STATE_GATED_IDS, sdd/project-context.yaml absent, structurally inert). TDD Red/Green: RED captured by relocating the implementation out of the tree (per-fixture failures), restoration sha256-verified byte-identical; GREEN 46/46 both runtimes (verification/T-004/{red,green}-sh.log), independently re-run by the gate. Unlike T-001..T-003 this task ships a CLI with branch logic rather than a schema validator, so the suite additionally pins exit codes 0/1/2/3 per branch outcome, stdout/stderr channel separation, the argument-error class for every mandatory flag, and branch-precedence conflicts (Policy-Weakening vs major bump vs digest-unchanged short-circuit).
